brief: Overnight risk-off: US S&P futures were down 50bps as the tech selloff continued, with sharp declines in Taiwan, KOSPI and Japan, then Germany; German PPI printed hot (8.1% vs 7.1% expected), and CTA liquidation hit copper, gold and crude. Growth-scare fears pushed the 10-year yield below 5% to 4.98%, with bitcoin holding near $61.8k. On Deere: corporate commentary has improved (Deere's early order program up 5%, AGCO guiding to 15-20%) even as the fundamental backdrop has deteriorated because crop prices rolled over. GS hears buy-side net income expectations near $5.7bn, below the $6.1bn consensus, and leans negative on Deere over six months; the stock, at $625 versus $700, is approaching 200-day support at $615. Fiscal 2026 should mark a trough, but the 25%+ rebound embedded in consensus is realistic at best. Keysight beat on EPS, revenue, orders and margins, guided Q1 well ahead, and expanded its buyback to $710mm; GS notes a beat-and-raise is unwelcome now because the market wants misses to find a bottom. AeroVironment's GIR dinner takeaways: two new contracts push the year near fully sold against 86% prior visibility, budget tailwinds continue into FY27, and the 2026 Investor Day margin target is 14.5% to 18-20% by FY30.
